[[File:Reward casket (easy) detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''[[reward casket]] (easy)''' is received after completing the final clue of an [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy clue scroll]] trail, and contains the final reward for the trail. Opening the reward casket is required for treasure trail completion to be tracked on the [[HiScores]] and [[collection log]].

The player can possess unlimited amounts of reward caskets up to the [[Stackable_items#Limit_of_a_stack|stack limit]]. Players are eligible to receive more clue scrolls regardless of how many reward caskets are in the player's posession.

==Rewards==
Easy clues generate a minimum of 2 rewards and a maximum of 4, granting an average of 3 rewards per casket. The rewards consist of generic items, shared treasure trail items and items that are unique for easy clues. Additionally, players have a 1/50 chance to receive a [[master clue scroll]] upon opening an easy casket.

All droprates are confirmed by [[Mod Tide]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Tide|url=https://twitter.com/JagexTide/status/1131933683714330624|date=24 May 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106558|archivedate=24 May 2019|quote=I know its been a while since the clue expansion but here is the information on clue scroll drop rates and loot chances! If anything changes I will keep you posted.|name=Clue rates tweet}}{{CiteGeneral|url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16pVNHdZyynmxIbM9mynRDYT0LQsWxq-vbDs4_7DpnGM/edit?usp=sharing|title=Clue scrolls 2019|author=|time=24 May 2019}} The listed rarities are per roll.

The average loot roll is worth {{Coins|floor({{EasyClueValue}})}}. On average, easy clues are worth {{Coins|floor(3 * {{EasyClueValue}})}}. The 1/50 chance of receiving a master clue scroll adds another {{Coins|floor(1/50 * (6 * {{MasterClueValue}} + 1/15 * {{MasterMimicValue}}))}}, for a total expected value per clue of {{Coins|floor(3 * {{EasyClueValue}} + 1/50 * (6 * {{MasterClueValue}} + 1/15 * {{MasterMimicValue}}))}}.

The probability to receive a clue scroll unique item from an easy casket is 247/1080, or roughly 22.9%.{{Efn|The chance for a unique is 1151/14040 per roll, with an average of 3 rolls per easy casket.}} On average, it will take 7908 reward caskets to obtain all the unique drops specific to easy clues (not including drops shared by other clue tiers).

==Rewards on Entrana==
Caskets opened on [[Entrana]] will not reward unique items, weapons, or armour.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1276268920270393348|date=25 Jun 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104301|archivedate=9 Dec 2020|quote=It rolls the table without such items being included, yeah. That also includes most equipable items, even items without stats such as Bob shirts. But it's a useful place to go if you want prayerbook pages.}} This makes the remaining items roughly twice as common.

The average easy casket opened on Entrana is worth {{Coins|3*{{Average drop value|mob=Reward casket (easy)#Entrana|raw=yes}}}}, not including master clue rewards (see {{Section|Rewards}}).
